audience: real estate transaction coordinators and teams using Open To Close

useCases.title: Review property assignments
useCases.text: List properties with their team and agent summaries, then review the related team and agent directories.

useCases.title: Inspect a property’s tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks associated with a property and read a selected task’s recorded details.

useCases.title: Find contacts for a property
useCases.text: Search contacts by name or email and review the contacts associated with the selected property.

useCases.title: Create a contact after checking for duplicates
useCases.text: Search existing contacts, confirm the requested details and create a new contact when needed. Creating it does not attach it to a property.

useCases.title: Add a confirmed property note
useCases.text: Review existing notes, confirm the property, content and visibility settings, then add the requested note. Inspect current notes before retrying an uncertain result.
